_note: Very short single words: Google returned near-silence for the bare word, so it is sent with a full stop. Texts with a placeholder are sent as they should be read. "je … desto", "um … zu" and "ohne … zu" also carry IPA sound hints ("sounds"): without them Google read a French "je", an English "um" and "zu" as "su". (Every "…" is sent as "...": see synth.py.) "circa" is sent as "zirka" (the German spelling of the same word): read as "circa" it sounded Spanish. "verdiene" carries an IPA sound hint: flagged in the voice log as not sounding German.
Von Mainz nach Frankfurt sind es circa f: Von Mainz nach Frankfurt sind es zirka fünfzig Kilometer.
